properties.notes: Demolition of the existing buildings and redevelopment of site to provide 84 bed care home (Use Class C2) 31 self-contained residential flats (Class C3) and community room at ground floor level (Use Class D1). The new building is part five and part four stories high, set over lower ground and four upper levels and includes balconies/terraces to the front and rear. New podium deck and associated landscaping and gardens at rear lower ground and upper ground floor levels.
